mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 325, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to combined pressure of high rates and high inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS>3.5 AND CPIAUCSL>325, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 325), a federal funds rate above 3.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to aggressive monetary tightening risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL>325, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to stronger economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above 159000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100.5 and housing starts (HOUST) are below 1240, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to conflicting signals of economic strength and weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO>100.5 AND HOUST<1240, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to concerns about real estate sector weakness and broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1250, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
